{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Navy blue wool-blend dress coat, tailored waist with a notched lapel, deep navy (#001f3f), heavy wool.
Cream silk-blend blouse, relaxed collar with subtle pleating at the chest, knee-length, ivory (#FFFFF0), smooth satein weave.
Charcoal grey fine-knit skirt, pencil cut with an A-line flare starting below the knee, dark charcoal (#36454F), merino wool blend.
Black leather loafers, classic slip-on style with a low stacked heel, matte black (#1C1C1C), full-grain calfskin.
Gold vermeil pendant necklace featuring a small cross on a delicate chain, medium gold (#D4AF37), polished metal.
Why this outfit works: This ensemble honors the solemnity of church service with modest, elegant fabrics while transitioning seamlessly into a warm family lunch. The dark navy and charcoal palette respects traditional dress codes for worship, yet the cream blouse adds a touch of gentle lightness suitable for an afternoon gathering. Choosing natural wool and silk ensures comfort in autumn weather without needing an outer layer once outside the sanctuary, maintaining a dignified yet personal silhouette throughout the day."}
